take: Per the Flames' announcement, Calgary recalled defenseman Brayden Pachal from the AHL and placed Kevin Bahl on injured reserve. Bahl was a top-pair defenseman averaging 21:29 a night and killing penalties, and Calgary controlled 51% of the 5-on-5 expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice, about 6 points better than without him. In the one game since he went out, Joel Hanley has moved in beside Nemec and Zayne Parekh is up to 22:20 a night from 18:07. For a team sitting at 7-9-1 with 45% of expected goals, that is a lot of minutes to reshuffle.
